note: Upload limits change often. confidence: official = first-party page read on the checked date; official-partial = first-party source for some fields only; third-party = vendor blog, not confirmed by the platform; conflicting = sources disagree (the lower figure is stored). Re-check before relying on any entry that is not 'official'. Limits are for organic uploads, not ads.

owner.note: Owner policy (2026-10-11): short-form never exceeds 5 minutes (hard ceiling) and targets at most 3 minutes by default; shorter is fine. Long-form length is undecided (null = no owner ceiling yet, only platform limits apply). Platform limits below still apply and are usually tighter.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.india_note: Largest video platform in India; Partner Program open to Indian creators.

short.label: YouTube Shorts
short.notes: Official page: up to 3 minutes; vertical videos uploaded as Shorts; max 1080p. The 3-minute limit replaced 60 s in Oct 2024 (third-party report). Vertical or square only (third-party).

long.label: YouTube video
long.notes: Official: 15 minutes by default; verified accounts can upload longer; absolute maximum 256 GB or 12 hours, whichever is less. Phone verification is needed for the verified tier.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.india_note: Main short-form platform for Indian creators since the TikTok ban.

short.label: Instagram Reels
short.notes: Official help page: aspect ratio between 1.91:1 and 9:16, at least 30 fps and 720 px. Length: Instagram head Adam Mosseri announced Reels up to 3 minutes (Jan 2025, Threads post). Newer vendor and news reports say the in-app camera records up to 20 minutes and camera-roll uploads up to 15 minutes, but I found no first-party page; Instagram only recommends Reels under 3 minutes. 180 s is stored as the safe limit.

short.label: X video (standard account)
short.notes: Official help page: standard accounts up to 140 seconds and 512 MB. Aspect ratios, codec and bitrate come from a vendor page (third-party).

long.label: X video (Premium)
long.notes: Official help page: Premium videos shorter than 4 hours at 1080p, up to 16 GB (above 2 hours is uploaded at 720p). A vendor page says 3 hours and 8 GB; the official page is used. Requires an X Premium subscription (paid), so treat as unavailable unless the owner enables it.

short.label: Threads video
short.notes: Threads API docs: up to 300 s, 1 GB, 23-60 fps, HEVC or H.264, MOV or MP4, AAC audio, max width 1920. The official Threads account also says videos can be up to 5 minutes. Short clips perform best (vendor guidance, not a rule).

short.label: LinkedIn video
short.notes: 5 GB and a 10-minute length are widely cited by vendors; LinkedIn's own help page could not be read (the fetch was blocked). Verify before depending on it.

long.label: LinkedIn video (landscape)
long.notes: Same unverified 10-minute / 5 GB figures as above.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.india_note: Blocked in India since 29 June 2020 and not on Indian app stores (vendor report, 2026). Disabled by default; enable only for a non-India audience or account.

short.label: TikTok
short.notes: Vendor pages disagree: 3 minutes for most accounts versus up to 10 minutes. TikTok's own help page only says the app asks you to choose a maximum length. The lower figure is stored. 287 MB is the mobile-app upload limit (vendor).
